description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry, which manages registration and retrieval of document type definitions (doctype objects) within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for registering doctypes, retrieving them by name or alias, creating doctypes based on configuration, and handling aliases.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry
classes.description: A registry class for managing doctype objects, allowing registration, lookup, aliasing, and creation based on configuration.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new doctype object in the registry, accepting either a fully-formed doctype object or parameters to construct one, and sets up any aliases.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a doctype object by name, resolving aliases; throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a clone of a doctype based on a configuration object, useful for configuring document modes.

methods.name: getDoctypeFromConfig
methods.description: Determines the doctype name from a configuration object, considering user-defined, custom, or standard doctypes with mode modifiers.
